name: Tabs
description: Content organized into switchable panels — e.g., pricing tiers, product comparisons, feature breakdowns by audience. Use when users need to switch between distinct content panels via labels. Don't use for simple show/hide (accordion is better for FAQs).
visualSignals: Horizontal tab labels at the top, content panel below that changes on click.

domInput.notes:
CRITICAL: The tabs block only renders the tab labels. Content for each tab MUST be authored as SEPARATE
sections in the document, each with a section-metadata block tagging it:
tab
Tab One
. Tab label text must match exactly between the tabs block and the section-metadata values.
